resolutionPolicy.coverage: Every distinct inputFixtureIds token in matrixFiles appears exactly once in fixtures.
resolutionPolicy.upstreamAliasRule: An upstream-looking token resolves to a checked-in file plus a real case or cell ID; the token itself is not authority.
resolutionPolicy.derivedRule: Derived E0 inputs name an exact checked-in or shared base and apply ordered test-owned mutations without production imports; a fixtureId reference resolves to that fixture's materialized payload, never to its ledger wrapper.
resolutionPolicy.unresolvedRule: A token without a real upstream anchor is listed in unresolvedTokens and is never treated as reviewed authority.

recipe.independentEncoding: Project public canonical key order, JSON strings with ECMAScript escaping, two-space indentation, LF, final LF; do not import production export code.
